title: Account-led feature curation and scoping-sparring play
creator: Priya Singh
description: This ticket defines a repeatable play for aggregating account-sourced feature asks from Sales and Customer Success and producing a lightweight, scoping-grade output that can drive prioritization decisions. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth with Sales/CS by providing a standardized scoring and sparring session (30- to 60-minute) where PM + 1 engineer + AE validate business intent, basic technical feasibility, privacy/regulatory constraints, and an initial effort bucket. The artifact delivered is an "account bundle brief" (single-page) and a normalized scoring row in the enterprise intake board.
decision_log: 2026-02-20 - Priya: Adopt two-tier scoring (value x confidence) instead of multi-factor weight that Sales found noisy.
2026-02-25 - Mateo: Engineering will provide an initial effort bucket (S/M/L/XL) with guardrails: S=1-3 dev-days, M=1-2 sprints, L=2-4 sprints, XL=requires cross-team plan.
2026-03-03 - Emily (Sales): We will pilot with 6 accounts and target features sourced from AE escalation channel only.
2026-03-08 - Security (J. Morales): Add a quick privacy flag checklist to surface PII/regulatory blockers; escalate if flagged.
comments: 2026-02-19 - Priya: Kickoff with Product + Sales ops; collected 18 candidate requests from AE channel.
2026-02-22 - Mateo: Spoke with infra lead about Dedicated capacity implications for 3 of the asks; likely requires Dedicated config changes.

acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page account-bundle brief produced for each aggregated account group (pilot: 6 accounts).
A2: Each brief contains: business value summary, target persona, required security/privacy flags, rough effort bucket, suggested rollout path (canary/regional/dedicated).
A3: Intake board shows normalized score (value x confidence) and a linked brief for each item.
A4: Pilot feedback collected from Sales and two PMs after 3 weeks; at least 4/6 briefs judged actionable by eng./infra.
A5: Documented playbook and templates available in Confluence and Drive; design template approved.
next_steps: Schedule 6 pilot scoping-sparring sessions (15–60 min) with AEs and assign owner for each brief (owner = PM).
Instrument intake board to capture score and links to briefs; add filters for 'privacy-flag' and 'requires-dedicated'.
Deliver small engineering spike tickets for briefs scored high value & feasible (create ENG tickets for pilot).
Collect pilot metrics: time-to-brief, % actionable, and average engineering estimate bucket.
Review at end of pilot and iterate template: remove confusion around weighting and tighten effort guardrails.
